name: Apothecarium
summary: In the Undercity’s southwest quarter, the Apothecarium drives the Royal Apothecary Society’s work. Under Master Apothecary Faranell, Forsaken alchemists pursue plagues, toxins, and engineered horrors for Lady Sylvanas’s campaign against the living and the Scourge.

sections.title: Chamber of Horrors
sections.body: Vats, dissection tables, and chemical fumes fill the Apothecarium’s southwestern terrace. Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society’s work there, studying mortality and rot. Alchemists and surgeons experiment with tissue grafts and vivisection, then assemble mighty abominations. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has charged them with making a plague to eradicate both the Scourge and the lingering human presence across Lordaeron.

sections.title: Center of Forsaken Alchemy
sections.body: Alchemists and herbalists come to this quarter from across the Horde in the Eastern Kingdoms. Initiates and masters gather beside toxic canals to distill concoctions and study botanical blights. They also seek counsel from master practitioners.

faq.q: What is the Apothecarium used for?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society researches and makes its wares in the Apothecarium. Forsaken alchemists brew experimental poisons, refine the New Plague, build abominations, and teach alchemy and herbalism there.
Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Apothecarium and its researchers. As chief scientist of the Royal Apothecary Society, he works with Queen Sylvanas Windrunner’s full authority and patronage.

faq.q: What is the Royal Apothecary Society trying to create?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks to create a lethal New Plague. It is meant to destroy the Lich King’s Scourge forces and the living human resistance contesting Forsaken territory in Lordaeron.
Yes. The Apothecarium is the Undercity’s main hub for alchemists and herbalists. Advanced trainers can be found along its walkways and in its chambers.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you rely on the Apothecarium for the chemical and stitched weapons needed to hold Lordaeron against overwhelming enemies.
As a herbalist, you supply the Royal Apothecary Society’s distillers with rare, blighted flora gathered from the northern kingdoms’ ruins.
